About Starfall Protocol

Starfall Protocol is a free 3D top-down shooter for your browser. Restore the relay, clear the hostiles and take down the Reactor Sentinel. It is built with Three.js, React and a physics engine, and everything you see is generated in your browser.

How to play

WASD
Move
Mouse
Aim and fire
Q
Dash
123
Blaster, plasma, pulse
E
Hold to activate the relay
Esc
Pause

Starfall Protocol needs a keyboard and mouse, so it is built for desktop and laptop browsers.

Tips

  • Walk to the amber terminal first and hold E. Enemies wake up as you get close, so clear a path first if it gets busy.
  • Dash with Q to slip through enemy fire. Your shield recharges when you stay out of danger.
  • Switch weapons to suit the fight. Plasma hits hard but drains energy, and the pulse gun spreads three shots.

Frequently asked questions

How do you play Starfall Protocol?

Move with WASD and aim with the mouse. Hold E at the terminal to restore the relay, clear every hostile, then destroy the Reactor Sentinel.

Can I play Starfall Protocol on my phone?

No. It needs a keyboard and mouse, so it works best on a desktop or laptop in a current browser.
